name: Procore
description: Procore is a construction management platform covering preconstruction, project management, financials, quality and safety, and field productivity for general contractors, specialty contractors, owners, and government agencies.
best_for: Construction companies and owners that want a single platform connecting the office and the field across budgets, drawings, RFIs, safety, and subcontractor coordination, and that are comfortable with an annual, volume-based contract rather than self-serve per-seat pricing.
features: Project management tools for RFIs, submittals, drawings, and daily logs shared between field and office
Financial management covering budgets, commitments, change orders, and invoicing
Quality and safety tools for inspections, observations, and incident tracking
Preconstruction tools for estimating, bid management, and design coordination
Resource management for scheduling labor, equipment, and materials across projects
Unlimited users, unlimited data storage, and unlimited 24/7 support included in every contract, per Procore's pricing page
Native iOS and Android field apps alongside the web platform
Open API and app marketplace for connecting other construction and business software
pros: Unlimited users, storage, and support included in every contract, so headcount growth doesn't add licensing cost
Covers the full project lifecycle, from preconstruction through closeout, in one connected platform
Volume-based pricing (via Annual Construction Volume) can scale more predictably than per-seat pricing for large field teams
cons: No published self-serve pricing — every contract requires a sales conversation and is quoted around a company's annual construction volume
No free trial; evaluating Procore means requesting a demo rather than signing up directly

pricing.starting_price: Custom — priced on Annual Construction Volume, not a flat rate

tiers.name: Custom (all plans)
tiers.notes: Priced around a company's Annual Construction Volume (ACV) — the aggregate dollar value of construction work managed through Procore — plus which Procore products are selected. Every contract includes unlimited users, unlimited data storage, and unlimited support at no extra charge.

alternatives.name: MaintainX
alternatives.description: A mobile-first CMMS for work orders, preventive maintenance, and asset tracking.
alternatives.best_for: Teams focused on maintaining existing equipment and facilities day-to-day, rather than managing the budgets, drawings, and subcontractors of active construction projects.
strengths: Self-serve pricing with a free plan
Fast setup without a sales cycle

faq.question: How much does Procore cost?
faq.answer: Procore doesn't publish flat prices. Contracts are quoted based on a company's Annual Construction Volume (the aggregate dollar value of construction work managed through Procore) and which Procore products are selected, with sales handling every quote.

faq.question: Does Procore offer a free trial?
faq.answer: Procore's pricing page does not offer a self-serve free trial; prospective customers request a demo or a custom quote instead.

faq.question: What's included in every Procore contract?
faq.answer: Per Procore's pricing page, every contract includes unlimited users, unlimited data storage, and unlimited support at no additional charge, with annual contracts for predictable pricing.

faq.question: What compliance certifications does Procore have?
faq.answer: Procore maintains SOC 1 Type 2 and SOC 2 Type 2 reports and ISO 27001:2022 certification, plus FedRAMP Class C certification for its government product.
